verdict.rationale: E2B's template docs say developers can define custom sandboxes by specifying the base image, environment variables, files to copy, build commands and a start command. Such templates can include pre-started running processes, and the CLI manages templates and creates sandboxes from them (`e2b sandbox create <template>`). Snapshots can also be saved as named templates. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bringing an existing container image (e.g., from a private registry) beyond choosing a base image, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the template build workflow.
